# La Fabrik Numérique

> La Fabrik Numérique is a software studio that builds custom websites and applications, and also ships its own SaaS products born from real, recurring needs: VoxCut (silence removal for audio/video), InOneShot (PDF mail merge), VectorPop (PNG/JPEG to SVG conversion), Nyctale (PC diagnostics), and VidScope (YouTube trend analysis).

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.lafabriknumerique.fr/): Studio overview, services, portfolio.
- [Blog — Journal de l'atelier](https://www.lafabriknumerique.fr/blog): Notes on the software the studio builds, technical choices, and behind-the-scenes decisions.

## Products built by the studio
- VoxCut → https://voxcutpro.com — silence removal for audio/video editing.
- InOneShot → https://www.inoneshot.fr — PDF mail merge from Excel.
- VectorPop → https://www.vectorpop.fr — PNG/JPEG to SVG conversion.
- Nyctale → https://nyctale.fr — free PC diagnostics.
- VidScope → https://www.vidscope.fr — YouTube trend and performance analysis.

## Key facts
- Custom software development studio (websites and applications) based in France.
- Also builds and maintains its own portfolio of SaaS and desktop products.
- Bilingual site (French/English).
